generation_rules.baseline: customer_id + transaction_type + category; at least five prior daily observations
generation_rules.amount_spike: 120 mature customers; final amount at least 5x prior daily median
generation_rules.income_outlier: 90 mature Income-credit customers; final amount at least 3.5x prior daily median
generation_rules.recurring_amount_shift: 72 two-occurrence shifts in genuine monthly recurring sequences, each 2.5x-3.5x prior levels
generation_rules.amount_convention: raw values vary in presentation; preprocessing assigns final signed amounts from direction
